pages.title: Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning - Springfield IL HVAC Contractor
paragraphs: Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning has been keeping Springfield families comfortable since 1987. We are a family owned and operated HVAC contractor serving Springfield, Chatham, Rochester and the surrounding communities. Our technicians are NATE certified and we service all makes and models of heating and cooling equipment.
We pride ourselves on honest pricing, clean work and showing up when we say we will. No high pressure sales, no surprise charges, and every job is backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

pages.title: About Us - Brannigan Heating
paragraphs: Ed Brannigan founded Brannigan Heating & Air Conditioning in 1987 out of a single truck and his garage on the north end of Springfield. Nearly forty years later the company runs eight trucks and employs fourteen people, but the approach has not changed: do good work, charge a fair price, and treat every house like it belongs to your own family.

We are fully licensed and insured in the state of Illinois, and every technician on staff carries NATE certification. We are also an accredited business with the Better Business Bureau and have held an A+ rating since 2004.
Ed started the company in 1987 and still answers the phone on Saturday mornings.
Katie runs the office, the schedule and the service contracts.
Marcus has installed more than two thousand systems across central Illinois.

headings.text: How often should I have my furnace serviced?
Do you offer financing on new equipment?

paragraphs: Fast diagnosis and repair for every major brand of central air conditioner. Most repairs completed same day, and we stock the common parts on every truck.
From emergency no-heat calls to planned high-efficiency furnace replacement, with financing available on new equipment.
Energy efficient heat pump systems sized correctly for your home, including ductless mini split installation.
Twice yearly tune ups that keep your equipment under warranty and catch small problems before they become expensive ones.
Whole home humidifiers, air purifiers, UV lamps and duct cleaning to help with allergies and dust.
Rooftop units, service contracts and planned replacement for small commercial buildings in the Springfield area.
Yes. We answer the phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays. Emergency calls are dispatched to an on-call technician immediately.
We recommend a professional tune up once a year, ideally in early fall before the first cold snap. Air conditioners should be serviced each spring.
We do. We offer approved credit financing with terms up to sixty months on qualifying new system installations.
All of them. Our technicians are factory trained on Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Goodman, Rheem and American Standard equipment.
